# package gooseops

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/iec61850ctl/pkg/gooseops"
```

Package gooseops implements the iec61850ctl GOOSE commands on top of github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/goose: listing control blocks from SCL, sniffing and subscribing to GOOSE streams, publishing, and rendering frames as text or JSON Lines.

## Functions

### func ApplyOverrides

```go
func ApplyOverrides(values []*mms.Value, members []goose.Member, assignments []string) error
```

ApplyOverrides replaces dataset values from "INDEX=VALUE" or "MEMBER-REF=VALUE" assignments, parsing each value as the member's type.

### func BareRef

```go
func BareRef(ref, iedName string) string
```

BareRef strips the IED name prefix from the MMS domain of an on-wire reference ("IED1LD0/LLN0$GO$gcb1" -> "LD0/LLN0$GO$gcb1"), the form used by servers whose MMS domain is the bare LD instance (go-iec61850, iec61850ctl server start).

### func FormatAppID

```go
func FormatAppID(id uint16) string
```

FormatAppID renders an APPID as 0xNNNN.

### func LoadControlBlocks

```go
func LoadControlBlocks(path string) (cbs []goose.ControlBlock, warning error, err error)
```

LoadControlBlocks parses an SCL file and resolves every GOOSE control block. Blocks that cannot be resolved are reported through the returned warning (nil when all resolved); a parse failure is an error.

### func ParseAppID

```go
func ParseAppID(s string) (uint16, error)
```

ParseAppID accepts hex ("0x1001", "1001") as written in SCL and on the wire; a "d:" prefix forces decimal ("d:4097").

### func ParseValue

```go
func ParseValue(raw string, ts mms.TypeSpec) (*mms.Value, error)
```

ParseValue parses raw as a value of the MMS type ts. Supported member types are boolean, integer, unsigned, float, visible/MMS string, bit string (hex, optionally "hex/len"), octet string (hex) and UTC time ("now" or RFC 3339). Structures and arrays are not parsed from text.

### func SelectControlBlock

```go
func SelectControlBlock(cbs []goose.ControlBlock, sel string) (*goose.ControlBlock, error)
```

SelectControlBlock finds a control block by name ("gcb1"), LD and name ("LD0/gcb1"), IED, LD and name ("IED1/LD0/gcb1"), or its gocbRef in either the on-wire form ("IED1LD0/LLN0$GO$gcb1") or the bare-LD form ("LD0/LLN0$GO$gcb1"). An ambiguous name is an error.

### func ValueJSON

```go
func ValueJSON(v *mms.Value) any
```

ValueJSON converts an MMS value to a JSON-friendly form: booleans, numbers, strings, bit/octet strings as hex, times as RFC 3339, arrays and structures as lists. Non-finite floats become strings.

### func WriteFrameText

```go
func WriteFrameText(w io.Writer, ev string, f *goose.Frame, rx time.Time)
```

WriteFrameText writes one human-readable line (plus values) for f.

#### func Subscribe

```go
func Subscribe(ctx context.Context, cfg SubscribeConfig) (SubscribeSummary, error)
```

Subscribe receives GOOSE through a supervised subscription and prints every event until Count valid messages arrived, the duration elapsed or ctx is done. It returns the supervision summary; an error matching errs.ErrTimeout means Count was not reached in time.
